text: Good evening please I don't know if I am disturbing you for nothing. My husband's son Tobi is 3 years, his temperature is 38.9 now. He is teething seriously, dribbling everywhere and putting everything inside his mouth to chew, one cheek is red like pepper. He said his throat is paining him small but he is drinking his water and juice fine. I checked his neck, he can bend and look down at his toes no problem. He is very awake o, sitting with me watching cartoon and talking plenty. Maybe it's just the teeth? I am not his mummy so I didn't want to take chances, abeg just advise me.
